name: Echo CS-352
blurb: A 34 cc homeowner saw: 16″ bars on 3/8″ low-profile chain, .050″ gauge, 57 drive links per Echo's own chart.
intro: The Echo CS-352 is a 34 cc homeowner saw. Echo lists a 16″ bar for the CS-352 on 3/8″ low-profile .050″ chain. Echo's Bars and Chains chart goes further than its specification table for this saw: the CS-352 block also lists a 12″ bar (12A0CD3745C, 45 drive links of 91PX45CQ) and a 14″ bar (14A0CD3752C, 52 drive links of 91PX52CQ), on the same 3/8″ low-profile .050″ chain. This page keeps to the 16″ bar the specification table gives, so if your CS-352 wears a shorter bar, take the count from its stamp. The 16″ loop is also sold as a 3-pack, 91PX57CQ-3.

bars.note: Echo bar 16A0CD3757C; chain 91PX57CQ. Echo’s specification table lists a 16″ bar for this saw.
